about:
LKQ Auto Parts of Lincoln operates at 3450 North 35th Circle in Lincoln, Nebraska. The location is part of LKQ Corporation, a national network of automotive salvage and recycled parts facilities. The page does not disclose the founding date of this specific site, nor does it identify individual founders or ownership structure beyond the corporate parent.

The facility functions as a salvage yard and parts distributor, offering used auto body parts, recycled components, remanufactured engines, rebuilt transmissions, and a full line of paint, body, and equipment supplies. Inventory includes radiators, wheels, tires, abrasives, detailing products, and refinish and coating materials. Customers can purchase on-site, arrange local delivery, or have parts shipped via common carriers with tracking. No facility square footage, employee count, or annual volume figures are published for this location.

The business serves collision repair shops, mechanical repair garages, and retail consumers seeking OEM-quality replacement parts. Testimonials on the site reference individual vehicle owners in Lincoln who obtained painted-to-match body panels and mechanical components. The company also lists "Replacement Automotive Labels" and "Keystone Automotive - Lincoln" among its served categories, indicating a mix of trade and consumer channels.

LKQ emphasizes that the bulk of its salvage-yard inventory consists of original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts installed by the vehicle maker. It differentiates itself by providing shipment tracking on delivered orders, a 30-day return window with core-charge refunds, and access to extended warranty options through the corporate website.
